name: Miner's House @ Ipoh
detail: From start to finish, the hospitality was on another level.

name: WEIL Hotel
detail: My son and I both really enjoyed our 3 night stay at Weil. The breakfast buffet is one of the best we have ever tried. ALL the Staff are nice and helpful and service at every level and dept are ALL excellent. The room is very comfortable and also on the 10th floor room we had the view of Ipoh surroundings is very nice, and esp the surrounding limestone hills / mountains. Another big asset is the hotel is connected to the Ipoh Parade Mall which has many kinds of good restaurants. Note that the hotel and most others fill up on weekends -- evidently filled up because of local foodie tourists coming to Ipoh, even foodies from Singapore. Ipoh till now has its excellent food (reputation) basically everywhere. Ipoh main lacking though is ease of transport. Going out of the hotel is quite easy but not going back. So Weil Hotel location is a plus too since it is so central and many places are within walking distance. We got a local 3G data card for our tablet and used that to navigate the streets. All in all I think Weil is likely the best hotel in Ipoh now. Weil is setting the bar now for real value and excellent comfort. And then of course is the everywhere food in Ipoh -- a main everyday pursuit for excellent taste and tummy happy time !!

name: M Boutique Hotel
detail: This is one of the best boutique hotel in Ipoh and the price is extremely reasonable. This hotel is decorated with modern mixed Europe steam punk design which is very unique. The hotel staff is very friendly and kind. The breakfast is quite good but it's have limited choice but the spread is fair enough. The hotel room is quite nice but just a little small, for those who is big size i would advise you to book a bigger room. The hotel is in good location. Overall this is one of the best hotel in Ipoh.

name: French Hotel
detail: Growing up in Ipoh, my impression of mid-priced hotels in Ipoh was not a favourable one. This Lunar New Year, I chose to have a one-night's stay at French Hotel in Ipoh New Town after seeing pictures in Agoda. True to what I saw in pictures, the rooms were modernly furnished and quite clean. The king-sized bed was comfortable for my wife and I. The bathroom was above my expectations and there was even rain shower. I called the reception desk regarding the hot water being lukewarm and help was rendered quite fast and effective. The staff were generally very efficient in serving guests. It is located not too far off the famous dim sum, taufu fah, white coffee places. I will definitely recommend tourists to Ipoh to stay at French Hotel Ipoh.

name: Hotel Excelsior
detail: Room are clean and very comfortable. Only problem are the toilet drain stuck and its smells awful..hope they fixed it asap. The other things that amazed me are the breakfast buffet ! There are many choice of breakfast that you can eat, nasi lemak, nasi kuning, ayam rendang, English breakfast, pancake, curry mee, chicken rice and much more... i was like.... WOW... how could you have such delicious breakfast and comfortable spacious room with only rm148 ? Believe me guys, this hotel is underated, it deserve more than 3 star. Best hotel i've stayed in ipoh.

name: The great hotel greenhill
detail: New renovations, all equipment are new and good quality one.

name: Cititel Express Ipoh
detail: Clean and spacious, the hotel meets most important needs of any family with children. They also go out of their way to assist with guests needs for a quick changeover of rooms, especially when some rooms smell of cigarettes even on a non smoking floor. This is due to the inconsiderate nature of previous guests, but the hotel crew take ownership and assist to their best. The security and parking area crew are ever friendly and reliable. Our favourite to stay hotel in Ipoh.

name: JQ Ban Loong Boutique Hotel
detail: Love that the location is superb. It is only walking distance to some of the highly recommended kopitiams in oldtown ipoh , and from the famous Concubine lane too. Hotel was simple with all the basic necessities fulfilled, they even provide water dispenser at the pantry. Kudos for helping save mother nature with that move(less water bottles to be thrown away!) Decor was also nice, in and out of the room. Love the tiles on the floor(u can get creative for some instagram posts). My only complaint? There isn’t enough storage space in the room, so it is more suitable for people who travel light. Will definitely recommend this place to everyone!

name: Ipoh Downtown Hotel
detail: Stayed with my elderly parents and we booked the family room which had a double bed and single bed. The rooms are new and modern, quite basic, but all that you would need. Room safe, fridge, fantastic shower with really hot water and option to use the rain shower, aircon, hair dryer, TV, free wifi. We didn't have breakfast in the hotel, but just behind the hotel are 2 of the best dimsum restaurants in Ipoh, serving good local fare. There are other restaurants nearby for dinner and there is a new shopping mall at 5 mins walking distance. It's a 20 min walk to Ipoh Old Town. The other good thing about the hotel was that they are affiliated with Ipoh Overland Tours and the hotel staff facilitated the tour bookings for day trips with your own driver to where you wanted to go.

name: Beds In Garden Hostel
detail: Best place for stay in Ipoh. Very clean bathroom, this is point plus for this hostel. Near from ipoh parade, restoran tauge ayam lau wong, dataran ipoh and very close with 7eleven. I'm stay at female dorms and nice choice if you're travelling alone. Nice staff. Will be stay in here again if I'm travelling alone.
